thread:
sara_sales: FYI Acme POC is blocked — IdP assertion looks fine but SCIM provisioning returns 403 on /Users endpoint. They say SSO works (users can log in) but our SCIM calls are rejected. Can someone help triage?

michael_se: Which environment? Hosted API keys or Dedicated pool?

sara_sales: Dedicated POC (dedicated-nyc). We also spun up a Private VPC trial but not using it yet. Primary problem is SCIM provisioning for groups -> they never appear in dashboard.

emma_customer: Confirming — SSO redirect/login ok. When we run provisioning sync we see 403 with body: `{"errors":[{"code":"access_denied","message":"SCIM provisioning disabled for tenant"}]}`. We didn't change anything on our IdP side.

aj_eng: Can you paste the raw IdP SAML attribute/claim mapping? Also which SCIM token did you put in Okta? We had a case where Okta sends group membership under `memberOf` and our SCIM mapping expects `groups` claim.

sara_sales: Sending metadata and the provisioning logs in a sec. tagging @michael_se and @ryan_sre.

michael_se: Quick checklist: 1) Ensure tenant has SCIM enabled (sales-demo acct sometimes not automatically turned on for Dedicated). 2) SCIM token scopes — needs `provision:users` + `provision:groups`. 3) If using IdP-initiated flow, ensure the SAML attribute used for externalId matches what our SCIM client expects.

emma_customer: We used the token from the Console > Integrations > SCIM section. It's the long token that starts with `si_`.

ryan_sre: I see a failed call in our logs at 2026-03-18T14:05Z from IP 35.201.XX.XX -> response 403. Response header:`x-rd-error: scim_not_enabled`. Looks like tenant feature flag not set for Dedicated. I'll flip it, but need approval from sales ops — leaving a note.

sara_sales: Oof — why didn't the provisioning step set it automatically? This is a POC booked via self-serve demo flow. The sales-op ticket didn't get created.

michael_se: For now, two mitigations: a) Enable SCIM feature flag for the tenant (ryan can do), b) If customer is blocked, we can provide a temporary hosted API key scoped for SCIM so Okta can provision users into a throwaway org — short-lived and isolates billing.

emma_customer: Hosting a temp key would be great so our SRE team can finish the onboarding today.

ryan_sre: Flipped flag for tenant `acme-corp-dedicated` and restarted the provisioning worker. I also pushed a small routing rule so SCIM calls go to the dedicated control plane instead of the private backend. Deploy bot: `deploy-bot: deployment/feature-toggle-service v2.9.1 rolled to prod (canary)` :rocket:

deploy-bot: deployment/feature-toggle-service v2.9.1 rolled to prod (canary)

aj_eng: Emma — when you run the Okta provisioning test, can you capture the full response headers and paste? Particularly `WWW-Authenticate` and any `x-rd-` headers.

emma_customer: Ran it at 14:18Z. Response now 204 but groups still not visible in Console. Provisioning response: `204 No Content`. Okta shows successful sync for users and groups.

michael_se: 204 means the SCIM side accepted the PATCH/POST. Next thing: our dashboard has delayed indexing from dedicated workers. For groups we run a background reconcile job. It can take ~30s-2m depending on queue. Could you verify after 5 mins?

emma_customer: Waiting... still not there after 6 mins. Any queue we can inspect?

ryan_sre: Checking reconcile job. I see a 500 in the group-indexer at 14:19Z triggered by a JSON schema mismatch — Okta is sending group `displayName` as array in this tenant due to an app rule. Example payload snippet: ```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
  "displayName": ["eng-team"],
  "members": []
}
```
We expect `displayName` string. That's why indexer failed and rolled back.

aj_eng: Ahhhh Okta has a custom mapping that accidentally wraps `displayName` with `toArray()` or something. Ask their IdP admin to change the mapping to a string. Meanwhile we can accept both shapes if we patch the indexer, but that's a code change and not ideal during POC.

sara_sales: Can we do a quick transform in the ingress proxy to coerce `displayName` arrays to strings for this tenant only? That would be the fastest fix.

michael_se: We could add a tenant-specific request transformer for SCIM payloads. Ry should be able to toggle it in edge config. Risk: might hide buggy customer mapping, but acceptable for short POC.

ryan_sre: Done — added transient transform rule that normalizes `displayName` to first element if array. Enabled for `acme-corp-dedicated`. Re-running reconcile job now.

emma_customer: Reconcile succeeded! Groups now visible. Thanks.

sara_sales: Nice work. Next follow-ups: 1) Ask Acme to fix Okta mapping (we should not rely on transform long-term). 2) Sales ops to update onboarding flow to ensure SCIM feature flag is set for Dedicated POCs. 3) Add a quick note to the POC checklist about group/displayName array edge case.

michael_se: I'll file an internal ticket to make the indexer tolerant to array/string and add an e2e test for Okta's edge mapping.

emma_customer: Appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll revert the temporary transform after we fix mappings on our side — keeping it on for the next hour while we finish QA.

sara_sales: Closing the thread for now. Marking as resolved in the POC tracker and adding the remediation checklist. :white_check_mark:
